svg.title: How a request to GitHub ends
svg.desc: A bot asks GitHub through the GitHub CLI, and a list is read with all its pages. An answer without an error is the answer, and so is a 404 where the bot asked what is there. After a gateway that timed out or a rate limit, the request waits as long as GitHub asks, 5 seconds or a minute, and tries once more, unless the wait would be longer than 90 seconds. Any other error, also a 404 to a change, fails the request, and settings apply names the part and the permission that the release app may lack.
